title: Saudi Aramco profits jump 33% in second quarter as Iran war squeezes oil supply
summary: Saudi Aramco reported a 33% profit increase in Q2, driven by elevated oil prices resulting from the Iran conflict and supply constraints. This reflects broader industry gains as major oil companies benefit from geopolitical tensions affecting energy markets.
content: The results come as oil supermajors have reported blowout quarterly profits, benefitting from higher fossil fuel prices amid the Iran war.

zh.title: 伊朗战争挤压油供，沙特阿美第二季度利润跃升33%
zh.summary: 沙特阿美第二季度报告利润增长33%，由伊朗冲突导致的油价上升和供应短缺所驱动。这反映了更广泛的行业收益，大型石油公司受益于影响能源市场的地缘政治紧张局势。

title: BP profit more than doubles as Trump blasts Big Oil for ‘making too much money’
summary: BP's profits more than doubled as the company benefits from higher fossil fuel prices amid the Iran war, drawing criticism from President Trump who accused Big Oil of excessive profiteering. The results underscore tensions between energy industry gains and political pressure on fuel costs.
content: The result come after U.S. President Donald Trump lashed out at Big Oil for making "too much money" off higher fuel prices amid the Iran war.

zh.title: 英国石油公司利润翻倍，特朗普抨击大石油公司"赚钱过多"
zh.summary: 英国石油公司利润翻倍，受益于伊朗战争期间化石燃料价格上升，但遭到特朗普总统的批评，他指责大石油公司过度获利。这些结果凸显了能源行业收益与燃油成本政治压力之间的紧张关系。

title: Treasury yields are broadly flat as investors mull uncertainty around peace talks
summary: The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield held steady at 4.686% as market participants weigh the implications of ongoing diplomatic negotiations. Bond markets remain cautious amid geopolitical uncertainty affecting interest rate expectations.
content: The yield on the 10-year U.S. Treasury note — the key benchmark for U.S. government borrowing — was flat at 4.686%.

zh.title: 投资者权衡和平谈判不确定性，美国国债收益率基本持平
zh.summary: 美国10年期国债收益率保持在4.686%，市场参与者权衡持续外交谈判的影响。在地缘政治不确定性影响利率预期的情况下，债券市场保持谨慎态度。

title: Trump warns Iran talks are ‘last chance’ to end war — oil prices rise as Tehran denies negotiations
summary: President Trump characterized the current round of Iran negotiations as a final opportunity to resolve the five-month conflict, prompting oil price movements even as Iran disputed claims that talks are occurring. The rhetoric underscores the interconnection between diplomatic efforts and energy markets.
content: President Donald Trump has warned that the latest round of negotiations with Iran are the "last chance" to bring an end to the five-month conflict.

zh.title: 特朗普警告伊朗谈判是"最后机会"以结束战争——德黑兰否认谈判时油价上升
zh.summary: 特朗普总统将当前一轮伊朗谈判描述为解决五个月冲突的最后机会，即使伊朗对谈判正在进行的说法提出异议，这也引发了石油价格波动。这种言辞强调了外交努力与能源市场的相互联系。

title: CNBC Daily Open: A U.S. yen intervention dressed in euros
summary: Washington reportedly sold euros to finance its intervention in currency markets, employing an indirect approach to avoid directly impacting the sensitive Treasury market. This strategy reflects efforts to manage multiple currency pressures simultaneously.
content: Reports suggest that Washington sold euros to fund its intervention to avoid impacting the sensitive U.S Treasury market.

zh.title: CNBC每日开盘：美国用欧元掩饰的日元干预
zh.summary: 据报道，华盛顿出售欧元以资助其对货币市场的干预，采取间接方式以避免直接冲击敏感的国债市场。这一战略反映了同时管理多种货币压力的努力。

title: AI is helping Grab ship products more than 30% faster, CFO says, as company raises forecasts
summary: Grab reported Q2 results showing that AI integration has accelerated product delivery by over 30%, leading the company to raise its full-year financial guidance. The results demonstrate measurable business gains from AI adoption in operational efficiency.
content: Grab reported second-quarter results on Tuesday and raised its full-year outlook.

zh.title: 首席财务官表示，人工智能帮助Grab提高产品交付速度30%以上，公司提高预测
zh.summary: Grab公布的第二季度结果显示，人工智能整合使产品交付加速了30%以上，导致公司提高了全年财务指引。这些结果证明了人工智能在运营效率方面采用带来的可衡量的商业收益。

title: Could heatwaves make your food shop more expensive?
summary: Rising temperatures are prompting supermarkets to adjust operations and costs, potentially leading to higher prices for consumers on food items. Climate impacts are beginning to influence retail economics and supply chain expenses.
content: As temperatures rise, the chillers might not be the only thing supermarkets are adjusting.

zh.title: 热浪会让你的食品购物变得更贵吗？
zh.summary: 气温上升促使超市调整运营和成本，可能导致消费者食品价格上升。气候影响开始影响零售经济和供应链成本。

title: Horror bookshop in fight to stay open amid cost rises
summary: A specialty horror bookshop faces financial difficulties exacerbated by reduced customer traffic during recent heat waves and broader cost increases. The situation highlights how climate conditions and economic pressures are threatening small independent retailers.
content: A drop in customers caused by the recent heatwave has increased financial pressures for the owner.

zh.title: 恐怖书店在成本上升中为保持营业而奋力斗争
zh.summary: 一家专门的恐怖书店面临财务困难，最近热浪期间客流量减少和更广泛的成本增加加剧了困难。这种情况突出了气候条件和经济压力如何威胁小型独立零售商。

title: HSBC pretax profit beats estimates, boosted by higher net interest income and fees
summary: HSBC delivered better-than-expected pretax profits, driven by gains in net interest income and fee revenue. The results suggest the bank is benefiting from higher interest rates and strong client activity in core business lines.

zh.title: 汇丰银行税前利润超出预期，受净利息收入和手续费提升推动
zh.summary: 汇丰银行实现了超出预期的税前利润，由净利息收入和手续费收入的增长推动。这些结果表明该银行正从更高的利率和核心业务线的强劲客户活动中受益。

title: Stock futures rise slightly after rip-roaring rally leads Dow to record closing high: Live updates
summary: Major U.S. stock indices surged Monday with the Dow reaching a record closing high, driven by Amazon becoming the first publicly traded company to exceed $3 trillion in market capitalization. The milestone reflects growing investor confidence in Big Tech's long-term growth potential.
content: The major stock averages surged Monday, with the Dow closing at a record high, as Amazon eclipsed $3 trillion in market cap for the first time.

zh.title: 股票期货小幅上涨，道琼斯指数创历史新高：实时更新
zh.summary: 美国主要股指周一大幅上涨，道琼斯指数创历史新高，由亚马逊成为首家市值超过3万亿美元的上市公司所推动。这一里程碑反映了投资者对科技巨头长期增长潜力信心的增强。

title: US states sue to block Trump tariffs impacting dozens of countries
summary: U.S. states have filed lawsuits to block Trump tariffs affecting dozens of countries, which were imposed on claims that 60 trading partners failed to address forced labor issues. The legal challenge represents growing state-level opposition to the tariff policy.
content: The duties were imposed over claims that 60 US trading partners have failed to tackle forced labour.

zh.title: 美国各州起诉阻止影响数十国的特朗普关税
zh.summary: 美国各州已提起诉讼，阻止影响数十个国家的特朗普关税政策。这些关税基于60个贸易伙伴未能解决强迫劳动问题的声称而实施。此项法律诉讼代表了各州对该关税政策不断增长的反对声浪。

title: India to raise up to $3.3 billion by selling stake in country’s largest life insurer at 10% discount
summary: India's government plans to raise $3.3 billion by selling a discounted stake in the country's largest life insurance company. The divestment represents a significant effort to boost government revenue.
content: Indian government plans to raise up to $3.3 billion by selling its stake in the country's top life insurance company.

zh.title: 印度计划以10%折扣出售该国最大人寿保险公司股份，筹资33亿美元
zh.summary: 印度政府计划通过以折扣价出售该国最大人寿保险公司的股份来筹集33亿美元。这次资产剥离代表了印度政府提高政府收入的重大努力。

title: Why is Trump Media selling early access to Trump's Truth Social posts?
summary: Trump Media offers early access to Truth Social posts from influential accounts at costs up to $100,000 monthly, providing subscribers milliseconds of advance notice before public posting. The premium service represents a new monetization strategy for the social platform.
content: The service reportedly costs up to $100,000 (£74,170) per month and offers access to posts from influential accounts milliseconds before they appear online.

zh.title: 特朗普媒体为什么在销售特朗普Truth Social帖子的提前访问权?
zh.summary: 特朗普媒体以每月最高10万美元的成本为有影响力的账户提供Truth Social帖子的提前访问权，为订阅者提供毫秒级的提前发布通知。该付费服务代表了该社交平台的新的盈利战略。

title: ‘We have always been civil’: My sister refuses to replace me as executor. Can I step down before she dies?
summary: An executor seeks guidance on stepping down when their sister refuses to name a replacement, highlighting complexities and family tensions in estate administration. The situation underscores the importance of clear succession planning in will provisions.
content: “I haven’t seen my sister since our mother’s funeral more than 20 years ago.”

zh.title: "我们一直很文明":我的姐姐拒绝替换我作为执行人。我能在她去世前辞职吗?
zh.summary: 一位执行人寻求关于在其姐姐拒绝任命替代人选的情况下辞职的指导,突出了遗产管理中的复杂性和家庭紧张关系。这种情况强调了在遗嘱条款中明确继承计划的重要性。
